summary: Independently rebuilt all 29 net groups from spec.parts (47 parts, 213 mapped pins) and compared them pin-by-pin with built.nets: the two sides are set-identical (29 nets, 213 pins, 0 unconnected, no duplicate NC assignment), GND/3V3/VBUS/VBAT each carry >=1 drawn power flag (14/11/2/5), the PCB net groups reduce to the same 29 sets, mechanical.netcheck.match is true with an empty issues list, and the only advisory is the un-flagged supply-looking PROT_VDD node, so there is no error-severity finding.

findings.msg: Advisory only: PROT_VDD reads as a supply rail (DW01A pin 5 VDD, fed from VBAT through R11 100R and decoupled by C4 100nF to CELL_N) yet built.nets shows flags=0, i.e. no power symbol was drawn on it; it is not one of the four nets listed in spec.powers (GND/3V3/VBUS/VBAT), all of which do have flags, so this is not a POWER_FLAG_MISSING rule violation.
findings.fix: Cosmetic, no pin-to-net change needed: if a drawn power flag is wanted, add "PROT_VDD": "up" to the powers map in design.json so the generator emits a power port on that net; otherwise leave design.json as is.
